## Overview

A half-blue, half-white dragon bonded to the air genasi ranger Nyra through air essence resonance. Khel'vin was critically injured by a divine agent ~20 years ago and later found Nyra as a lost 6-year-old. He raised her in the mountains, teaching her to hunt and survive. His flight is permanently impaired from the injury.

---

## Appearance

Enormous blue-scaled dragon with white dragon lineage visible in pale underbelly scales and ice-blue frills. Left side bears deep scar tissue from the rockslide -- left wing partially collapsed, one eye permanently closed. Frost patterns along the spine from white dragon heritage.

---

## Background

Born ~210 YA to a blue dragon mother and white dragon father. Learned storms and wind from his mother. From his father: **Cold Breath** (freezing exhalation), mastered ~100 YA.

**Divine Attack (~14 YA)**: Khel'vin discovered fragments of truth about the gods' conspiracy -- that the monster invasion was orchestrated. A divine agent triggered a rockslide to silence him. He was pinned for days until 6-year-old Nyra found him.

**Essence Resonance**: Nyra's latent air genasi essence resonated with Khel'vin's blue dragon nature (storms and wind). He absorbed enough power to lift the rocks.

**Raising Nyra**: Searched for her parents for 1 year. No trace found. Became her guardian. Taught her to hunt, track, survive. Grumpy, mocking, fiercely protective.

**Cavern of Discovery**: Used Cold Breath to freeze the Air Elemental, enabling Nyra's killing blow. Declared them "even" and parted ways.

---

## Abilities

| Ability | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Blue Dragon Traits | Lightning breath, storm affinity, natural arcane absorption |
| Cold Breath | Freezing exhalation learned from white dragon father ~100 YA |
| Essence Resonance | Air-essence bond with Nyra; proximity amplifies affinities |
| Impaired Flight | Left wing permanently damaged; cannot fly for sustained periods |

---

## Current Status

Alive. Location unknown. Parted ways with Nyra after the Cavern of Discovery. May be recovering in isolation, investigating his past, or watching from a distance.
